parents: iteration 8 (reports/failures/paper_loop_20261003.md; research/observations/evidence_post_migration_hours_train_20261003.txt): 1-24 h post-migration decisions on momentum / near-ATH / market cap, 4 h means -13% to -16%, medians -2%..+2%
H-CLEANMIG (reports/failures/agent_cleanmig.md): structural filter AT MIGRATION, entry 30 min / 2 h, holds 4/24 h, gross -24% to -39%; reserve already 20-50 SOL 30 min after migration
how_this_differs: Conditions on SURVIVAL, not on structure at migration: the pool must still hold a true SOL reserve >= Y (85 = the migration reserve, or 150) at age 6 h or 24 h, i.e. the 30-minute decay CLEANMIG measured has NOT happened to it.
Gate is a demand-breadth DERIVATIVE (distinct traders rising, net buying), not price momentum / near-ATH / market cap (iteration 8's filters).
Exact constant-product fills on logged reserves with the swap rows' real fee bps (iteration 8 used 15-min GeckoTerminal bar opens and a flat 2% per side).
Decision ages 6 h and 24 h: past the steepest hazard (68.7% of tokens stop trading on day 0, lead).
parents_and_difference.honest_prior: Low. Iteration 8's strongest subsets had ~0 medians and -13% to -16% means at 4 h because of collapses; the growth gate may not remove collapses. Ranked first only because it is the closest test of the round-10 survivor lead that this tape can score in 24 h windows.

data.tape: data/raw/web/pumplean/ (hourly files + parts/), loaded with the views in reports/hypotheses/pumplean_notes.md
data.pool_creation_sources: data/market.duckdb amm_pools (read_only, created <= 2026-10-05 03:40Z, old-recorder gaps), data/raw/web/pumplean/seed_pools.parquet (Oct 5 03h-05h), pumplean amm_pools (live from 2026-10-05 10:43:17Z)
data.no_holdout_overlap: the lean tape does not overlap holdout_plan.md windows; market.duckdb is used only for pool creation rows (pool, mint, recv, quote_in) of pools created before the tape, never for outcomes

splits.warmup: 2026-10-05 10:43:17 -> 12:04:00Z: history for features only, never an entry
splits.validation: entries in [2026-10-06 12:04:00Z, 2026-10-07 12:04:00Z), examined once, only for the one config selected on train, only if the train kill test passes
splits.forward: entries from 2026-10-07 12:04:00Z to end of recording (2026-10-08 12:03:58Z unless extended); never used to tune
splits.assignment: a trade belongs to the segment of its entry time; exits may run past a boundary but never past the end of data (such trades are dropped and counted, outcome-blind)
splits.disclosed_overlap: 12 h train exits fall in the validation calendar window; only those pools' exit states are read

coverage_rule.covered_minute: both streams have msgs > 0 in the events.jsonl 'minute' event AND the reconnect holes (disconnect.last_slot..resume.first_slot, timed disconnect -> resume) inside the minute sum to <= 5 s per stream AND neither stream's msgs is below 30% of its trailing 60-minute median (suspect minutes are treated as NOT covered)
coverage_rule.gap: a run of non-covered minutes, or > 60 s with no curve trade; the declared outage 2026-10-05 12:03:04-12:03:59Z is a gap
coverage_rule.gap_list_first: the full gap list and covered hours per segment are written to the evidence file before any price or P&L is computed
coverage_rule.uncovered_minutes_excluded: no decision, entry or exit may be taken in a non-covered minute
coverage_rule.feature_window: the 4 h feature window (t_d - 4 h, t_d] must have >= 90% covered minutes, else skip (counted). Trader counts are therefore approximate inside short holes; this is tolerated and stated.
coverage_rule.fills_never_use_hole_states: the fill state is the next swap's logged pre-trade reserves (an on-chain state observed after the fill time), never a state derived across a hole

universe.pools: SOL-quoted PumpSwap pools from standard pump.fun migrations: amm_pools.quote_in within 0.05 SOL of 84.99, CreatePoolEvent on file (one of the three creation sources), hence in the recorder's young set with every swap >= 0.001 SOL in amm_swaps
universe.declared_holes: pools created 2026-10-05 05:05Z-10:43:17Z and in old-recorder gaps (e.g. 10-04 01:12-08:54Z) have no CreatePoolEvent and only other_5m bars: EXCLUDED (creation-time based, outcome-blind). Their count is reported.
universe.mayhem: excluded when curve_creates.is_mayhem (lean tape) or data/processed/mayhem_flags.parquet says True; unknown kept and counted

point_in_time_features.computed_from: amm_swaps rows of the pool with recv <= t_d (recv = recv_us/1e6); nothing after t_d
point_in_time_features.t_create: pool CreatePoolEvent receive time (amm_pools.recv / recv_us; seed created_us)
point_in_time_features.t_d: t_create + A rounded up to the next whole minute; if that minute is not covered, the first covered minute within 10 min, else skip (counted)
point_in_time_features.true_reserve_R: pool_quote_logged + offset_pool, offset_pool = median over the pool's sells with recv <= t_d of quote*(pool_base+base)/base - pool_quote (exact sell identity, agent_amm_flow / agent_lpsell_clock); needs >= 3 sells with IQR <= 0.05 SOL, else 17.585 if quote_in = 84.99 +- 0.05 (re-verified in step 0 on train sells; if the identity's median relative error > 1e-4 the scorer stops and amends before any P&L)
point_in_time_features.R_at_t_d: true reserve of the post-trade state of the last swap with recv <= t_d (token side = pre -/+ base; SOL side from the next swap's logged pre-state if it is in the same covered minute, else the documented ev_len rule)
point_in_time_features.active: >= 10 swaps and >= 5 distinct users in (t_d - 60 min, t_d]
point_in_time_features.growth_gate: distinct users in (t_d - 2 h, t_d] >= distinct users in (t_d - 4 h, t_d - 2 h] AND net buy SOL (gross buy SOL - gross sell SOL) over (t_d - 2 h, t_d] > 0

trade.exit: sell all tokens at t_d + H + 1 s; no stop (CLEANMIG and BOOST: stops gap through and cut recoveries)
trade.fill_state: conservative rule of agent_amm_flow: entry at the HIGHER-priced of (pool state at fill time = logged pre-trade reserves of the first swap with recv > fill time, + offset) and (state after the first swap within 5 s after the fill time); exit at the LOWER-priced of the same two, additionally marked down to the next swap's pre-trade state when that is > 2% lower
trade.constant_product: buy: x = size / (1 + f); tokens = T * x / (R + x).  sell: SOL = R * q / (T + q) * (1 - f). R, T = true reserves of the fill state.
trade.fee_f: (lp_bps + proto_bps + cc_bps)/1e4 of the swap row that defines the fill state (the pool's real tier at fill time). Step 0 re-verifies on train rows that |quote - user_quote| = total fee for both ev_len versions; if the buy-side form differs, the more expensive of x = size/(1+f) and x = size*(1-f) is used.
trade.own_impact: our buy is not added to the pool before the exit (conservative: the exit sells into a pool without our earlier buy)
trade.stale_exit: if no pool swap in [exit fill time, +60 min], sell into the last observed post-trade state and flag 'stale'; sensitivity values stale exits at 0
trade.tx_costs: 2 tx per trade, each tip/priority fee 0.001 SOL (main) or 0.01 SOL (sensitivity) + 5,000 lamports base fee. ATA rent is refundable (account closed in the sell tx) and not charged.

grid.gate: growth gate ON for all 8 A x Y x H configs (selectable)
grid.controls: growth gate OFF at A = 6 h, Y in {85, 150}, H in {4 h, 12 h}: 4 configs, NOT selectable (they measure what the gate adds)

step0_allowed_before_pnl: gap list; covered hours per segment; offset/fee identity checks on train sells and buys (no returns); eligible counts per config per segment (no prices beyond the R >= Y gate, no returns). Any amendment (e.g. a config with 0 eligible trades replaced) must be written into this file with a timestamp BEFORE any return is computed, and may not grow the grid above 12.
kill_test_train: K1: at least one selectable config with train n >= 20 has net SOL > 0 and PF > 1.0 (0.5 SOL, tip 0.001, main fills). Otherwise FAIL; validation not examined.

K2 (mechanism): pooled over Y and H at A = 6 h, the mean gross mid-to-mid return of gate-ON trades must exceed the gate-OFF controls' by >= 2 percentage points. Otherwise FAIL (the gate is the hypothesis).
selection_rule: If K1 and K2 pass: among selectable configs with train n >= 20 that meet net > 0, PF > 1.2 and net ex top-3 > 0 (0.5 SOL, tip 0.001), pick the ONE with the highest net ex top-3 SOL; ties -> larger n. If none meets it: FAIL, validation not examined. Train n < 50 is expected and is stated with the selection.
validation: Score the one selected config once on validation. No parameter, filter or fill rule changes after this point.

bar.n_below_50: INCONCLUSIVE; the frozen config continues unchanged on the forward segment and the bar is applied to validation + forward pooled once n >= 50 (forward-only figures also reported)
bar.tip_and_size: 0.01 tip and 0.1 SOL results always reported; a PASS with net <= 0 at the 0.01 tip is labelled 'tip-fragile' and not promoted without review

reported_not_selected_on: mid-to-mid gross return; main vs non-conservative fills
skip reasons: excluded creation hole, mayhem, feature-window coverage, decision minute uncovered, exit past data end
expected_n: Unknown (tape not opened). Round-10 OWN counts on the old tape: 4-19 pools a creation day at 24 h with reserve >= 200; 10-71 with >= 10 trades. n >= 50 in one 24 h window is unlikely at A = 24 h; INCONCLUSIVE is a likely outcome and is acceptable.
